speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the detailed history. To better understand the nature of your rash and neurological symptoms, can you describe the specific appearance of the rash on your palms and whether it blanches or peels? Additionally, have you experienced any joint pain or muscle weakness?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Dermatitis Herpetiformis. The combination of a pruritic rash, sensory changes in the palms, and your occupation with livestock strongly suggests a gluten-sensitive enteropathy or potentially scabies, but given the chronicity and specific distribution, celiac disease with cutaneous manifestations is the primary concern. I will need to see your blood work regarding IgA levels and request a dermatology referral for a skin biopsy to confirm.
